query: SELECT x.id, x.kind, x.slug, x.name, x.retired FROM guide_taxon x WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM guide g WHERE g.published_at IS NOT NULL AND g.published_topic_id = x.id) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM guide_tag_assignment a JOIN guide g ON g.id = a.guide_id WHERE a.taxon_id = x.id AND a.scope = 'published' AND g.published_at IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY x.retired, lower(x.name), x.slug
